ModMetaData.name: Selective ReTend
ModMetaData.author: JG
ModMetaData.description:
Re-tend an existing treatment selectively and without wasting medicine.
Treatments are considered in this order: 1. Infections 2. Diseases and other treatable conditions 3. Injuries
Each category can be enabled independently and has its own target quality. Infections and diseases use the best medicine allowed for the patient; injuries use the weakest medicine that can reasonably reach their configured target.
Diseases cured through accumulated tend quality are deliberately excluded to prevent repeated tending from bypassing their normal treatment interval.
Inspired by the concept behind ReTend by Temmie3754 and MrKev. Selective ReTend is an independent implementation.
